criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect all exact final views against original scope. Personally inspected all visible concept panels at22:01:10–22:01:31UTC. Keep broad paddle leaves, woody ascending framework and root flare. Correct exaggerated diamond bark scales to three discrete oval scars; ensure flattened sprays rather than isolated terminal giant leaves. Airy crown and modest root spread, not spruce or modern broadleaf maple.

Verify A full woody tapering tree with ascending perennial scaffold limbs, branch scars, modest root flare and an upright broad vase-like crown, selecting the low-tree Fig9 hypothesis from Snigirevsky et al.2025. Flattened pinnate leafy sprays carry broad paddle/fan-shaped leaf units, not needles, compound conifer tufts, a fern rosette, flowers or fruits. Clear bare lower trunk and structurally branching upper crown; art abstraction preserves individual leaves and asymmetric branch distribution. Conservative whole-organism exterior concept selecting the published Fig9 low-tree macrophyllous reconstruction, not a fossil scan or unique proven crown. Published figure height3.5–4m is its reconstruction choice; our3.8m is an art scale. Crown architecture/ecobiomorph relationships are debated. Leaf size/count, branch count, root details and color are stylized. Do not count Callixylon wood as a second asset. No copied image composition or source mesh.
